subject: Class and category of data items and literals
notes: kb/Work PB1398 landed (wave 1004 D). A national function result is the data item of category national with an implicit usage national (cite.py --check 8.5.2.10 'an item is referred to as a national' OK; 15.2 item 3), admitted by 15.50.3 r1 / 15.14.3 r1 through 8.4.3.2.1. LENGTH counts national positions (15.50.4 r2): NATIONAL-OF(X) over a 3-character item is 3; BYTE-LENGTH is 2 bytes per national position (D-N1), 6 (CobolIntrinsics.ByteLengthNational).
